policy: This benchmark is the agreed review contract for the LE Lab domain-relevance gate. Cases are append-only: existing cases are never edited or removed, and new cases enter only by explicit agreement between the maintainer and the reviewer, in a commit that changes no classifier code. Gold labels were chosen to be unambiguous to a careful human reader; deliberately borderline passages were excluded, because the gate's fail-open triage UI (visible set-asides plus per-passage overrides) is the designed handling for genuinely uncertain text. The gate is deterministic lexical triage: meeting these thresholds does not claim open-world generalization, and a fresh adversarial paraphrase falling outside these families is expected occasionally to misclassify — visibly and reversibly, never as silent data loss.

labels.retain: The gate must keep the passage in analysis (status relevant or uncertain).
labels.ignore: The gate must set the passage aside (status irrelevant).

domainRecall.meaning: Share of expected-retain cases actually retained. Guards against silent loss of relationship-domain claims.

ignorePrecision.meaning: Of everything the gate sets aside, the share that is genuinely non-domain. Guards against the gate binning real claims.

junkRecall.meaning: Share of expected-ignore cases actually set aside. Quality metric: misses are retained in the fail-open direction, visible in the triage-labeled ledger, and excludable by hand. May only be raised, never lowered.

achievedAtFreeze.note: Measured against the classifier at freeze time (2026-07-26). Every junkRecall miss at freeze was a fail-open retention of a polysemous trap; none was silent.

appends.agreement: Maintainer + adversarial reviewer sign-off on md/lab-benchmark-append-proposal-01.md; systematic fix (dating-app-interaction frame + sexed participant terms) landed separately in the preceding commit. Measured after fix: 134 cases at 1.000 / 1.000 / 0.806.

Maintainer append under the LE Lab parser-improvement objective. UNLIKE append #1, this block is committed RED — with the shipped build failing all seven positives — deliberately. The red state is the record that the gap predates the fix: md/lab-canon-alias-pass-01.md sections 4 and 5 found that four seduction-register probes and three ratified-alias probes were rejected `no-human-relational-frame` before the matcher ever saw them, and concluded 'no alias change can fix a passage that never reaches the matcher.' Committing the fix first would have left only the maintainer's word for that.
appends.composition: 7 positives, 11 negatives (1.6:1, above the 1:1 floor). All seven positives are VERBATIM probe sentences recovered from the alias pass, not paraphrases. Negatives are freshly written and adversarially close: three sports senses of `game`, three video-game senses, one sports sense of `playing games` aimed at ds-02, one sports sense of `out of X league` aimed at ds-05, one recruiting parallel of ds-06, and two `rizz`-as-generic-praise cases.
appends.ambiguousCases: ds-08 is flagged for Jason. Its bare form ('his game was off last night') is genuinely two-way and the ignore label rests on a disambiguating clause. Per the fixture policy, deliberately borderline passages are excluded; this one is included WITH the disambiguation and the ambiguity recorded rather than silently resolved.
appends.measuredAtAppend: 152 cases · domainRecall 0.9054 · ignorePrecision 0.9014 · junkRecall 0.8205 — RED, below both hard thresholds. All seven ds positives were being set aside by the shipped v2.2.0 build.
appends.measuredAfterFix: 152 cases · domainRecall 1.000 · ignorePrecision 1.000 · junkRecall 0.821 (up from 0.806). Not one of the frozen 134 changed status or reasonCode.

appends.agreement: Maintainer ruling: adopt option 1 from md/lab-gate-cultural-register.md. Committed RED, following the ds-* precedent, so the record shows the gap predates the fix. The gate retains claims ABOUT relationships and discards claims about CULTURE SHAPING relationships, which is the register most of the archived manosphere corpus is written in; six of eight minimal pairs in tests/fixtures/cultural-register-pairs.json split on a single word. Nine of the ten positives isolate the missing frame - each carries a participant term, a cultural force and a shaping verb, and no relational-outcome trigger, so nothing existing can retain them. cr-07 is the deliberate exception, already retained via the non-decisive relationship-concept frame at 2.2, kept to guard the existing path. The six negatives are the boundary the fix must preserve: culture-and-shaping with no human participant, or in a non-mating domain, stays out. No classifier code changes in this commit, per the append policy.

Maintainer append under the LE Lab parser-improvement objective, landing with md/lab-gate-participant-vocabulary.md and changing no classifier code. Reason for the append: of the 84 expected-ignore cases before it, ZERO contained the vocabulary the four candidate participant widenings would add and exactly one contained P3b's, so "junkRecall unchanged" was evidence the benchmark could not see the change rather than evidence the change was free. These twelve give it eyes. Measured after: the shipped gate bins 11 of 12, which RAISES junkRecall 0.833 -> 0.844 — and it rises because cases the gate already passes were added, not because the gate improved. pv-07 is the exception and is a pre-existing false positive, not one an option buys.
